profile.name: Steve
profile.overview: Steve is an unorthodox counterhit and rushdown character. As a boxer, he does not use kicks, with the kick buttons instead acting as evasive boxing weaves. He excels at suffocating his opponent with endless pokes and strings, chipping them down if they freeze up, and counterhitting them if they swing back in desperation. His infamous Quick Hook (b+1) is the best counterhit tool in Tekken 8, which combined with his many other counterhits off of strings and other moves, allow him to greatly benefit from getting a beat on his opponent's timing.
profile.playstyle: An unorthodox boxer built on counter hits and rushdown. His kick buttons are weaves and stance moves, not kicks. Duck and weave (LWV, RWV, DCK) under the opponent's attacks, catch their buttons with some of the best counter-hit tools in the game (Wavu), and stay compact so you are hard to whiff punish. He has no standard i15 launcher and a steep learning curve.
strengths: Counter-Punching Paragon: Some of the best counter hit tools in the game.
Compact: Very difficult to whiff punish overall.
Float Like a Butterfly, Sting Like a Bee: Plethora of stances and strings to confuse and outwit opponents.
Flame On! Great set of Heat Engagers.
You Wanna Try Me, Guv? Heat makes his strings even more oppressive with chip damage, and temporarily makes him a bonafide grappler.
weaknesses: Auto-pilot Disabled: Beginner unfriendly with a deep learning curve.
Stiff to Use: No standard i15 launcher (i16 crouch, i17 standing) makes for a fairly rigid counter hit fishing gameplan and allows other characters to be more liberal with their unsafe moves.
Parry Spam Hater: Susceptible to punch-exclusive parries or sabakis.
Doesn't Hit Below The Belt: Weak set of lows.

keyMoves.purpose: Fast check; 1,1,2 is his i10 punish (Wavu).

keyMoves.summary: Left Uppercut: i13 mid, -2 on block, can weave with 3 or 4.
keyMoves.purpose: His safe mid check into weaves.
keyMoves.use: To stop ducking and start weaves.

keyMoves.summary: i12 punish string (Wavu: 2,1 and 2,2 at -12), -5 on block.
Quick Hook: i13 high, launches on counter hit (+61a), -14 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: One of the best counter-hit tools in the game.
keyMoves.avoid: -14 on block; it is a high.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Wavu BnB: CH b+1 into a 56-damage combo.

keyMoves.summary: Quick Draw: homing high string, +3 on block.
Bounty Hunter: i17 homing high, +5 on block.
keyMoves.use: To keep the turn and catch steps.

keyMoves.summary: Sonic Fang: i14 mid Heat Engager, -12 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: An i14 punish that starts Heat.

keyMoves.summary: Dreadnought Uppercut: i17 tornado with jab evasion, -15 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: His standing launcher (he has no i15 one, Wavu).
keyMoves.use: After -17 moves and to duck jabs.

keyMoves.summary: Finishing Blow: i16 tornado from crouch, -15 on block.
i22 spike that launches (+52a), -14 on block.
keyMoves.use: As a read or whiff punish.

keyMoves.summary: Knee Blaster: i16 low, -13 on block.
Low Cross Blaster: i19 low, -18 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: A low that can go into Peekaboo (PAB).

keyMoves.summary: Eraser: i20 mid from a run, +6 on block, Heat Engager.
keyMoves.use: To close distance and start Heat.

keyMoves.summary: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
